Sheet: @UUID[Actor.doLuya2qqzFb2wqn]{Halvard Brekke}

Concept: former crab fisherman, childe of Sheriff Montgomery, and member of his pack.

Hal is the grandson of Norwegian fishermen from Ballard. He spent his summers on the Bering Sea, on boats where someone died every season. He was the one who never got seasick, the one who went out on deck in thirty-foot waves. In 1994, a storm sank his boat. He was the only one who made it to shore alive, half frozen, on a beach where Montgomery was hunting.

Montgomery (@UUID[JournalEntry.1UgmJAqeofD7SSaf]{Ethan Montgomery}) Embraced him that night because he saw someone who didn't know how to give up. Since then Hal has been one of Whitmore's Wolves (@UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.bxduXJhh2oXcM6Uy]{COT-01 · Whitmore's Wolves}): he tracks, covers up, and keeps watch. He has known David for thirty years. He was the backup who reached the apartment the night Emily died, and he was the one who cleaned the scene while David was still on his knees. They've never talked about it. He feeds on fishermen and longshoremen in the waterfront bars (Alleycat).
The File has a 2023 cell phone video of a man running after a car, faster than the car. It's him.

Ambition: earn a domain of his own. Desire: for Montgomery to tell him, just once, that he did well. Suggested Conviction: “Never leave anyone in the water.” Touchstone: his niece Ingrid, who now captains the family boat and saves him a seat at the Christmas table even though he never comes.
Allies (longshoremen) 2, Contacts (port police) 1, Mawla (Montgomery) 2, Haven 1 (a boat moored in Salmon Bay).

@UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46} (tracking), @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.wQ2BqzruUybEIhSO]{A2-E04 · The Sheriff That Was} (works David's corner against O'Connor), @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}, @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.hAX2tLfjRPJ2o4Tr]{A3-E03 · Face to Face with Krell} (he was in Emily's apartment in 1996), @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}, @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.cGEW4b4hCJlaDeSK]{GAN-12 · The Visited Grave}.

Years ago, Montgomery ordered him to watch David and report back. Hal has done it every month. Now that David runs with the coterie, every report covers them too. In @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}, when the Sheriff hesitates, he's going to ask for Hal's reports. Hal has to decide what to tell him.
